document: Gate 5 Final Closure — Forensic Telemetry Amendment
scope: Corrects telemetry defect in Gate 5 enrichment report; does NOT alter enrichment data

forensic_summary.description: The original Gate 5 summary (v0.4) reported cache_hits=0. This was a telemetry defect in EnrichmentAPIClient.get_metrics_summary(), which calculated cache_hits by counting APIRequestMetrics with cache_hit=True — but cache retrievals bypassed query_endpoint() entirely and never created an APIRequestMetrics. The defect is NOW FIXED (see api.py v0.4.1). The 4,744-record enrichment dataset and raw evidence cache are unchanged and verified correct.
forensic_summary.original_bug: cache_hits = sum(1 for m in self.metrics if m.cache_hit) — always zero because cache retrievals never created APIRequestMetrics
forensic_summary.fix: Explicit counters (logical_endpoint_queries, endpoint_cache_hits, records_reused_from_cache, records_requiring_network, failed_network_requests) added at EnrichmentAPIClient level, independent of HTTP RequestMetric collection. Invariant: logical_endpoint_queries == network_requests + endpoint_cache_hits enforced in tests.

derivation.records_total: All records from 5-domain selection (4 priority + 1 contrast)

endpoint_failure_rates.note: Zero failures across all 7 endpoints. Endpoint stats below count network calls only (4238 per endpoint).

scientific_description_correction.corrected: Exhaustive Ground Truth enrichment of 4,744 IGME records across five selected hydrogeological domains
scientific_description_correction.note: Internal filenames containing 'cohort5000' preserved for backward compatibility and provenance. Do not rename immutable artifacts.

tests: test_cache_hit_does_not_affect_latency — no latency/byte pollution from cache

cache_hits.explanation: 506 Gate 4 records were fully cached (7 endpoints each = 3542 cache hits). The v0.4 summary incorrectly summed APIRequestMetrics.cache_hit flags, which cache retrievals never set.

total_requests.correct_description: This correctly represents network_requests, not logical_endpoint_queries. Renamed for clarity.

verdict: PASS — Gate 5 enrichment validated and telemetry corrected
